name: Advance the Years
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a lock of an elderly person’s hair)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell causes magical, permanent aging in the target. All of the normal effects of aging apply (e.g. ability score adjustments) as if the target had aged those years naturally. On a failed save, the target ages 1d10 years.
